t:
Which of the following are not examples of operational phase policies?

I. Machinery Insurance
II. Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance
III. Advance Loss of Profits (ALOP)
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In which of the following market does the term 'contract work' refer to special cover which is a combination of CAR and EAR insurances to suit the needs of projects involving substantial amount of both civil construction and machinery installation?
e: Correct answer: Europe (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a boiler and pressure plant insurance policy, liability towards employees for death or bodily injury arising out of and in the course of employment is excluded. Argue. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: Liability towards employees for death or bodily in
e: Correct answer: This statement is correct (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
KFC limited is an infrastructure company. It has taken a Contractor's All Risk (CAR) insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses shall be covered by Contractor's All Risk (CAR) insurance policy?

I. Damages due to accident on site because of defective cement
II. Penalty imposed by contract labour inspector
III. Damage of packing material due to water leakage
o: None of I, II and III
e: Correct answer: None of I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Protech Limited is a construction company. It has taken a Comprehensive Project Insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses shall be covered as per the CPI policy?

I. Damages to material due to flood
II. Damages to machinery due to short circuit
III. Accidental damage of tools by falling
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The acquisition of land is a very easy and minor part of an infrastructure project. Give your opinion.
o: The acquisition of land is a major landmark and difficult part of an infrastructure project
The acquisition of land is a minor but difficult p
e: Correct answer: The acquisition of land is a major landmark and difficult part of an infrastructure project (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Suhas works for an insurance company which deals in EAR and CAR policies. He wants to find out endorsement wordings from the London Market pertaining to limited defective condition exclusion. Which set of wording should he refer?
e: Correct answer: DE 3 (from the IC77 question bank).

t: This stage of risk management determines the extent to which the resources can be affected in terms of physical damage, injury, interruption, liability etc. Identify this stage.
e: Correct answer: Risk evaluation (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are the determining factors for delayed start up insurance in a CPI Policy?

I. The length of the construction, erection
II. General risks and risks associated with the project
III. Spare parts planning and/or spare capacity
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Shipra Ltd. is a cloth manufacturing company. It wants to take an insurance for the machinery installed in its factor. Which type of insurance should the company take?
e: Correct answer: Machinery Insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The estimated "Commercial Operation Date (COD)" is an important parameter because:-
o: It is the starting END point from which the delay
It is the date from which the insurance policy com
It helps in calculating the sum insured
It is the starting point from which the delay period is measured
e: Correct answer: It is the starting point from which the delay period is measured (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The sum insured for the delay in start-up process in a CPI policy equates either to a declared gross profit or to specified standing charges for the maximum indemnity period, subject to a minimum of ________ operation.
e: Correct answer: 12 months (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In a standard MLOP policy, when does the indemnity period terminates?

I. End of one year from issue of policy
II. Production reaches normal level existing at the time of the occurrence of the insured peril
III. Expiry of the number of months selected by the insured
o: I or II whichever is earlier
II or III whichever is earlier
e: Correct answer: II or III whichever is earlier (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In an ALOP Policy, how is the sum insured calculated if it is based on Debt service charges?
o: Amortisation of machinery minus interest cost
Amortisation of machinery plus interest cost
e: Correct answer: Amortisation of machinery plus interest cost (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following factors are considered while awarding a contract in a large project?

I. Price quoted for the contract
II. Financial guarantee of the contractor
III. Experience of the contractor
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Arijit is a project manager for an commercial engine manufacturing company. He is in charge of a project. Advise him after which stage can he invites tenders for construction of project building?
e: Correct answer: Detailed project planning (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
ABC Company is planning a new infrastructure and construction project to start their new product line. They are also planning to take various types of project insurances. Help them to identify the various stages of a project.

I. Transportation of product properties
II. Site activities
III. Profit and loss analysis
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In EEI insurance, which of the following sections indemnify the insured against any physical loss or damage to electronic equipment due to earth quake?

I. Material
II. External data media
III. Increased cost of working
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a 'Hydrocarbon Endorsement For Testing & Commissioning' Article 3, each and every claim shall be subject to an excess / deductible franchise of 5% of the value of catalysts in the system subject to a minimum of __________ which is the hot testing period excess.
e: Correct answer: Rs.2,50,000 (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The boiler and pressure plant insurance policy indemnifies the insured against:

I. Damage to insured item
II. Damage to other surrounding property of the insured
III. Liability for third party property damage
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
As per the machine insurance, in cases where the damage can be repaired, the cost of restoration shall include which of the following costs?

I. Normal freight
II. Erection cost
III. Duties and taxes
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The Erection All Risks (EAR) insurance policy is more popularly known in India as ___________.
e: Correct answer: Storage-cum-Erection (SCE) insurance policy (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a deterioration of stock (Potatoes) in cold storage insurance policy, what is the maximum liability of the insured company?
o: Net realisable price subject to deductibles
e: Correct answer: Insured value (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the examples of general exclusions in Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy.

I. Loss discovered at the time of taking inventory
II. Depreciation of tools due to normal usage
III. Rusting of iron parts of plant and machinery
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a comprehensive project insurance policy, the details of 'project's construction and erection works insurance' are mentioned in which section?
e: Correct answer: Section 1A (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following act as additional covers to a Comprehensive Project Insurance Policy?

I. Off-site storage up to the agreed limit of indemnity
II. Cleanup costs resulting from an indemnifiable loss
III. Inland transit for sundry local supplies up to an agreed limit of indemnity
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Sameer works for an insurance company which deals in EAR and CAR policies. He wants to find out endorsement wordings from the London Market pertaining to defective part exclusion. Which set of wording should he refer?
e: Correct answer: DE 4 (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The sum insured in a CPM insurance policy should represent the new replacement value of the items including which of the following items?

I. Transportation cost to site
II. Customs dues
III. All installation costs
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In a standard EAR and MCE policy, containing endorsements for civil engineering works, which of the exclusions apply?

I. Cessation of work whether total or partial
II. Loss or damage directly caused by derangement
III. Any loss of property due to shortage revealed during and after an inventory verification is made
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In 1954, syndicate of five Companies was formed in eastern India with a view to pool their resources and expertise and come to a sharing agreement for transaction of engineering and allied risks in India. Which among the following was not a part of syndicate?
e: Correct answer: UK INSURANCE COMPANY (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In risk management, risk inspections play an important role. Which among the following is the role of risk management?

I. Provide information as to acceptance of risk
II. Give recommendation to the insured for loss prevention
III. Give ecommendation to the insured for loss minimisation measures
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The machinery insurance is also known as ______________.
e: Correct answer: Machinery Break Down Insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Boiler Pressure Plant policy no excess is required. Argue. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: Boiler Pressure Plant policy is  subject to an exc
e: Correct answer: This statement is wrong (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following establishments can be termed as factory under the Indian Factories Act?

I. Where 10 or more persons are working
II. Where 10 or more persons were working in last 12 months
III. Process is carried without the aid of power
e: Correct answer: II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following statement/s is/are correct for CECR insurance?

I. CECR policies are meant to replace the existing fire policies
II. CECR policy is primarily taken to protect civil structures from damage due to fire
III. CECR policy is suitable for dry docks and harbours
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which one of the following is not mandatory for an establishment to be termed as factory under the Indian Factories Act?
o: Where 10 or more persons are working
Where 10 or more persons are working in last 12 mo
Is spread in an area of 20,000 square feet with boundary wall
Process is carried with the aid of power
Process is carried without the aid of power
e: Correct answer: Is spread in an area of 20,000 square feet with boundary wall (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following types of machinery are excluded from the cover of machinery leasing insurance?

I. Underground installations
II. Ships
III. All types of aircraft
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Deepak Industries has an auto parts manufacturing factory. It has taken a machinery insurance policy for its machines. The owner wants to know which of the following losses shall not be covered under the policy?

I. Damage due to mechanical break down of machinery
II. Loss due to machine man's fault
III. Damage due to molecular fatigue
o: Neither of I, II or III
e: Correct answer: Neither of I, II or III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following will not be classified as 'Mine' as per the definition of mine under the Mine Act 1952?

I. All boring, bore holes and oil wells
II. All open cast workings
III. Premises, where ten or more workers are working, in any part of which a manufacturing process is being carried on with or without the aid of power
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following are not generally found in a Contractor's All Risk Policy?

I. Material Damage Section
II. Third Party Liability Section
III. Endorsement Section
o: Neither I, nor II, nor III
e: Correct answer: Neither I, nor II, nor III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following shall constitute as electronic equipment for an Electronic Equipment Insurance?

I. Boilers
II. System Software
III. Air Conditioner
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Propose an alternative for a reinsurer who doesn't want mandatory acceptance of reinsurance but simply a choice to accept or reject it.
o: Go for a non-proportional reinsurance contract
e: Correct answer: Go for facultative reinsurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t: During which stage of project planning, the principal will pay the contract price to the contractor in installments at predetermined intervals in accordance with the progress of the work as per provisions of the works contract?
e: Correct answer: Site activities (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Five sets of Endorsement wordings are available from the London Market for the Defect Exclusion (D.E.) Wordings. Which set pertains to DE 3?
e: Correct answer: Limited defective condition exclusion (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Contractor's All Risk (CAR) insurance does not provide cover during the maintenance period or defects liability period to fulfill the obligations under the contract. Argue.
o: This statement is wrong as CAR insurance provides
e: Correct answer: This statement is wrong (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a MLOP Policy, there is a provision in the Policy for downward adjustment of the sum insured up to 50% at the end of the policy period, if:-
o: Sum proposed for insurance exceeds the actual gross profit of the business
Actual gross profit  of business exceeds the sum p
Sum proposed for insurance exceeds the actual net
Actual net profit  of business exceeds the sum pro
There is a loss sustained during the year
e: Correct answer: Sum proposed for insurance exceeds the actual gross profit of the business (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
With reference to a MLOP Insurance, which of the following are considered as Insurable Standing Charges?

I. Water charges for production process
II. Heating, cooling, lighting and power charges for administrative building
III. Miscellaneous expenses which are 7% of the total standing charges
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the general exclusions in a Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy?

I. Liabilities due to accident caused by vehicles licensed for general road use
II. Loss due to Collision
III. Cost for rectification of error occurred during installation of machinery
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: MSAU was founded by a group of engineers in 1854 for the purpose of inspection and revision of steam engines and boilers.  What does MSAU stand for?
e: Correct answer: Manchester Steam Users Association (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Who issues a certificate for registration of a Boiler, authorising its use in an industrial unit under the Indian Boilers Act?
e: Correct answer: Chief Inspector of Boilers (from the IC77 question bank).
